answer: In an autonomous agent economy monitoring an emission plume across lotus fields and willow wetlands, Sybil attacks are mitigated through bonded hardware attestation. Agents must lock capital deposits and execute operations within tamper-resistant enclaves that sign every action. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of forfeited collateral and scarce physical microchips for each fake identity. However, trusted hardware remains vulnerable to side-channel key extraction.
